name: sambhav-platform
description: Sambhav Game Theory Society — full-stack club platform (Arena, LMS, attendance, events).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @sambhav/game-core && npm run build -w @sambhav/api && npm run build -w @sambhav/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @sambhav/game-core && npm run test -w @sambhav/game-core && npm run test -w @sambhav/api && npm run test -w @sambhav/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sambhav/game-core && npm run typecheck -w @sambhav/api && npm run typecheck -w @sambhav/web
scripts.e2e: npm run build -w @sambhav/game-core && npm run build -w @sambhav/web && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.coverage: npm run build -w @sambhav/game-core && npm run test:coverage -w @sambhav/game-core && npm run test:coverage -w @sambhav/api
